referenceFunction.generalComment: The multioutput-process " hydrometallurgical treatment Li-ion batteries " delivers the co-products "disposal, Li-ion batteries, hydrometallurgical” ,”Co powder, hydrometallurgical processing Li-ion batteries, at plant”, “Li salt, hydrometallurgical processing Li-ion batteries, at plant”, “iron and steel, hydrometallurgical processing Li-ion batteries, at plant” and " non-Fe-metals, hydrometallurgical processing Li-ion batteries, at plant". The allocation is done 100% to the disposal process.; UUID: 10082f84-e556-4bc8-b2fd-44a29f723771
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset represents the treatment of Li-Ion batteries from electric and electronic devices by a hydrometallurgical process. It includes energy & auxiliary consumption, waste production, emission (to air/to water) production and rough estimations of the efforts for infrastructure & transportation.
